cases: Every packet matches the actual current adapter, local constants and scope limits
agri: actual local payload contains exactly the described fields for each scope selection
agri: exact expiry rejects a new local test while retaining old receipts
agri: withdrawal stops new tests and preserves the old snapshot

Unsupported top-level and nested payload fields are rejected
Missing metadata or selected summary, extra summary, unsupported or repeated scopes reject
Identifiers, times, versions, mapping and fixed contract values have no permissive fallback
Progress bounds and completed versus in-progress semantics are exact
Non-accredited status and sample-workflow combinations neither imply issuer authority nor widen
Only exact 1, 7 and 30 day choices are accepted, with canonical duration
Caller-injected approval, content version and payload cannot enter a command
Wrong partner mapping, private pin and mismatched retained version reject
Unknown historical version does not use the currently available curriculum
Invented or duplicate completed lesson IDs are refused by the actual command
Independent withdrawal works with paused learning, unknown pin and malformed history
Repeated withdrawal retains its first timestamp and does not remove history
Replacing a choice withdraws its predecessor but preserves prior local receipts
Future receipt, receipt before its choice and receipt at expiry are rejected
A receipt at withdrawal can remain history but a later one is rejected
Retained receipt wrapper identity must agree with payload and exact retained choice
Current practice status change does not rewrite a prior local snapshot
Paused or withdrawn learning rejects a new test while preserving retained choices
Receipt capacity rejects another test but permits independent withdrawal
Choice capacity retains history and independent withdrawal
Health, unknown ecosystem and legacy delivery never enable tests or transport
Actual domain source hashes remain unchanged
limits: No compilation, Worker, API, browser, saved storage or outbound requests. Local state is fictional and in memory only. Does not prove a live partner contract or institutional authorization.
